dimensions.title: Analysis by Dimension
dimensions.subtitle: Detailed breakdown of risk levels and gap scores by dimension
dimensions.popoverDesc: This table provides a detailed breakdown of risk distribution for each dimension across all submissions. It helps identify the areas of your organization most exposed to digital risks.
dimensions.highRiskDesc: The percentage of submissions where the dimension was assessed as presenting high risk. High-risk areas require immediate attention.
dimensions.mediumRiskDesc: The percentage of submissions where the dimension was assessed as presenting medium risk. These areas should be monitored.
dimensions.lowRiskDesc: The percentage of submissions where the dimension was assessed as presenting low risk. These are strengths.

high.title: High Risk Dimension and Recommendations
high.subtitle: Priority area requiring immediate attention
high.popover: This dimension has the highest average risk score across all submissions. It represents the most critical area requiring immediate action.

medium.title: Dimension Requiring Attention and Recommendations
medium.subtitle: This dimension shows a moderate gap - deserves monitoring and improvement
medium.popover: This dimension has a moderate average risk score. It is not critical but should be monitored and improved over time.

low.title: Dimension with the Greatest Improvement Potential
low.subtitle: All dimensions are performing well. This one has the greatest potential for further growth
low.popover: All dimensions show low risk. This dimension has the highest score among them, meaning it has the most room for progress, not that it is at risk.
low.recTitle: Suggestions to Further Strengthen this Dimension

focus.aboutDesc: The recommendations below are tailored to this dimension and can be integrated into your action plan.

chart.title: Dominant Risk Level by Dimension
chart.subtitle: Percentage of dominant risk level by dimension
chart.aboutDesc1: This bar chart visualizes the most dominant risk level (High, Medium or Low) for each dimension. The dominant risk is the risk level with the highest percentage of submissions for that dimension.
chart.aboutDesc2: This gives a quick overview of each dimension's overall risk profile, helping you easily spot dimensions that are consistently classified as high risk.
